short_description: Research-only panel-relative PGS signal for pain in arms, legs, or joints.
summary_note: This score estimates a cautious, research-only, reference-panel-relative genetic signal for pain in arms, legs, or joints.
what_it_measures: A polygenic score associated with Degree bothered by pain in arms/legs/joints in the past 3 months in PGS Catalog. It does not measure current symptoms, diagnosis, clinical state, or clinical risk for this user.
interpretation_template: Arm/leg/joint pain research signal is shown as a research-only genetic signal, not a medical result, diagnosis, screening result, treatment recommendation, prevention recommendation, or lifestyle recommendation. {interpretation}
caution_text: Research-only genetic signal. This is not a diagnosis, medical advice, screening, treatment guidance, prevention guidance, or a substitute for a clinician. Results depend on raw-file coverage and the local reference panel.
limitations: This is not a diagnosis, medical advice, clinical screening, prevention guidance, or treatment guidance.
The score does not measure current symptoms, disease status, laboratory values, behavior, or future clinical risk for the user.
Reference distribution is built from local raw files and may be small or ancestry-biased.
No genotype imputation is used, so missing variants can affect the estimate.
confidence_note: Confidence depends on raw-file coverage and overlap with scoring variants; it is not clinical, behavioral, or personal certainty.
reference_note: Reference panel: local empirical panel from available Autosomal raw files, excluding bot staging folders.
reported_trait: Degree bothered by pain in arms/legs/joints in the past 3 months
